misconceptions.description: Cramming scenario, constraints, and stress tests into a single huge prompt instead of separate labeled turns
misconceptions.trigger: learner writes one long prompt and reads only the final answer
misconceptions.feedback: Split the dialogue into labeled turns (SET CONTEXT, NARROW, STRESS-TEST). One turn per job lets a reader see which turn caused which change.

misconceptions.description: Describing the situation but never stating the limits (length, audience, what to avoid) that make the output usable
misconceptions.trigger: scenario paragraph has no constraint such as time, reading level, or audience
misconceptions.feedback: A scenario needs constraints. Add audience, length, and tone limits so the model has something concrete to satisfy.

misconceptions.description: Pasting the AI's full reply as the artifact without selecting or cutting any of it
misconceptions.trigger: learner keeps every line the AI produced, including duplicates
misconceptions.feedback: Select. If a turn returns two lines that say the same thing, keep one and log the cut. The selection is part of the evidence.
